channel.title: TIANZE Technical Guides
channel.description: Technical guidance for optical fiber coatings and photonics assembly adhesives.

item.title: How to Select an Optical Fiber Coating System
item.description: A practical framework for selecting primary, outer and specialty optical fiber coatings by fiber structure, process and finished-fiber validation requirements.

item.title: How to Specify Refractive Index for Optical Fiber Coatings
item.description: Learn which wavelength, temperature, material-state and test-method details are needed when comparing refractive-index data for optical fiber coatings.

item.title: How to Select Adhesives for FAU Head and Tail Bonding
item.description: A practical guide to separating head fixation and tail strain-relief requirements when selecting adhesives for fiber-array unit assembly.

item.title: How to Evaluate Coatings for Polarization-Maintaining Fiber
item.description: A practical framework for evaluating primary and outer coatings for polarization-maintaining fiber by geometry, process and finished-fiber performance.

item.title: How to Interpret Thermal Data for Polyimide Fiber Coatings
item.description: Understand why glass-transition, decomposition and processing temperatures are not interchangeable with continuous-use ratings for coated optical fiber.

item.title: How to Plan Microbend Testing for Coated Optical Fiber
item.description: Build a repeatable microbend evaluation by defining the coated fiber, cable structure, mechanical loading, temperature and optical measurement conditions.

item.title: How to Select Adhesives for PLC and AWG Optical Coupling
item.description: A practical framework for evaluating UV-curable adhesives for PLC, AWG and fiber-array coupling by bond geometry, cure access and alignment stability.

item.title: How to Specify Low-Index Coatings for Double-Clad Fiber
item.description: Define refractive index, wavelength, material state, cure process and finished-fiber tests when evaluating low-index coatings for double-clad and active fiber.

item.title: How to Select a Ceramic Ferrule Potting Adhesive
item.description: Evaluate ceramic ferrule potting adhesives by fill geometry, viscosity, substrates, thermal cure, shrinkage and finished-connector reliability requirements.

item.title: How to Evaluate Adhesives for Intermittently Bonded Ribbon
item.description: Plan IBR adhesive evaluation by fiber count, bond pattern, dispensing, cure process, ribbon rollability, handling and individual-fiber access requirements.

item.title: How to Evaluate Coatings for Hollow-Core Optical Fiber
item.description: Plan coating evaluation for hollow-core and microstructured optical fiber by geometry, draw process, cure, handling environment and finished-fiber tests.

item.title: How to Qualify Coatings for Radiation-Exposed Optical Fiber
item.description: Build a radiation-exposure qualification plan for coated optical fiber by dose, dose rate, temperature, atmosphere and post-exposure retention tests.

item.title: How to Evaluate Adhesives for Optical Fiber Coil Bonding
item.description: Evaluate optical-fiber coil bonding adhesives by winding geometry, adhesive placement, UV access, cure stress and finished-coil optical stability.
